candidate.answerReason: The five complete groupings produce 70, 46, 26, 50, and 70. There are four distinct values.

methods.label: Organize the groupings by the last operation
methods.explanation:
Parentheses change which operation is performed last while preserving the order of the numbers and operation signs. We can record every evaluation by adding enough parentheses to specify all operations.

If the first multiplication sign is performed last, the remaining three numbers have two possible groupings. If addition is performed last, the two products are fixed. If the last multiplication sign is performed last, the first three numbers have two possible groupings. These cases give all five complete groupings:
\[
\begin{aligned}
2\times((3+4)\times5)&=70,\\
2\times(3+(4\times5))&=46,\\
(2\times3)+(4\times5)&=26,\\
((2\times3)+4)\times5&=50,\\
(2\times(3+4))\times5&=70.
\end{aligned}
\]
Any fewer parentheses merely leave some of this grouping to the usual order of operations, so they cannot produce an additional value. The distinct values are \(26,46,50,70\); the repeated \(70\) counts once. Therefore there are \(\boxed{4}\) values, choice C.
